description: This file defines an interface for a bank account grain in an Orleans-based distributed system, along with related transaction classes for deposit and withdrawal events.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a generic transaction with a GUID, description, and timestamp.

classes.name: DepositTransaction
classes.description: Represents a deposit event with an amount.

classes.name: WithdrawalTransaction
classes.description: Represents a withdrawal event with an amount.

methods.name: Balance
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current account balance.

methods.name: Deposit
methods.description: Asynchronously deposits a specified amount into the account, with associated GUID and description.

methods.name: Withdraw
methods.description: Asynchronously withdraws a specified amount from the account, with associated GUID and description.

methods.name: GetTransactionLog
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the list of transaction events.
